title: JazzDeviceEnrollmentClaimV1Envelope
description: Canonical claim payload and a raw IEEE P1363 ES256 proof. The signature input is UTF-8("JAZZ-DEVICE-ENROLLMENT-CLAIM-V1\\0") followed by the decoded canonical payload bytes.

payload.description: Unpadded base64url of at most 8192 canonical JSON bytes conforming to JazzDeviceEnrollmentClaimV1Payload.

proof.description: Unpadded base64url of a 64-byte P-256 ECDSA SHA-256 signature in r||s IEEE P1363 form.
